title: Aureline M5 kernel-recovery-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the kernel_recovery_card family binds inside the frozen M5 notebook-kernel-output component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-notebook-kernel-output-component-matrix.schema.json). A kernel recovery card names which recovery action it offers and where recovery stands so a card offers reconnect / restart-clean / choose-another-kernel recovery without ever implying a rerun. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
